proof_object: Finite geometric collar construction obligation for reflected Wilson blocks.
target_commitment: Construct a collar object whose Wilson footprint supports the finite Schur-Feshbach theorem.
proposed_move: Build the first explicit H,K collar case and test the positivity and failure regimes.

conceptual_depth.evidence: The packet targets the missing geometric object rather than endpoint algebra.
conceptual_depth.demotion_trigger: Demote if no collar object is constructed.

explanatory_power.evidence: Explains why endpoint estimates are support-only until the collar exists.
explanatory_power.demotion_trigger: Demote if the explanation does not alter routing.

unification_power.evidence: Unifies finite Wilson block algebra with the geometric realization gate.
unification_power.demotion_trigger: Demote if only one isolated calculation remains.

mechanism_specificity.evidence: Names the H,K collar mechanism and positivity tests.
mechanism_specificity.demotion_trigger: Demote if mechanism is only metaphorical.

compression.evidence: Turns endpoint loops into one construction obligation.
compression.missing_evidence: Needs proof that the obligation subsumes the loop.
compression.demotion_trigger: Demote if endpoint branches remain ungoverned.

generativity.evidence: Creates an explicit next experiment and falsifier.
generativity.demotion_trigger: Demote if no falsifier is attached.

transfer_reach.evidence: This is a construction gate, not yet a transfer theorem.
transfer_reach.demotion_trigger: Demote if advertised as continuum transfer.

falsifiability.evidence: A collar with the wrong reflected support fails the positivity gate.
falsifiability.demotion_trigger: Demote if no failure case can be stated.

boundary_sharpness.evidence: Packet states finite-construction scope and non-claim boundary.
boundary_sharpness.demotion_trigger: Demote if it implies mass-gap transfer.

literature_displacement.evidence: Literature value is pending until the collar construction is compared to known Wilson/OS methods.
literature_displacement.demotion_trigger: Demote if the construction is standard.

transfer_substance_audit.definition_expansion_test: Not a transfer theorem; no definition-built target predicate is used.
transfer_substance_audit.independent_source_object_test: Source reflected Wilson block is specified independently.
transfer_substance_audit.independent_target_property_test: Target finite positivity gate is stated independently.
transfer_substance_audit.nontrivial_hypothesis_test: Uses the existence of an explicit H,K collar.
transfer_substance_audit.source_variation_test: Varying collar geometry changes the positivity outcome.
transfer_substance_audit.stress_case_test: Degenerate reflected support is the stress regime.
transfer_substance_audit.failure_case_test: A collar whose support misses the reflected footprint fails the gate.
transfer_substance_audit.consequence_delta: Endpoint work is correctly routed behind the collar construction gate.
transfer_substance_audit.prior_art_delta: Positions the result as a finite construction obligation rather than standard OS exposition.
transfer_substance_audit.repair_certificate: Build the H,K collar object and then run same-domain transfer audit.

declarative_learning_event.attempted_inference: Route endpoint work behind geometric collar realization.
declarative_learning_event.observed_result: The missing collar object is the decisive hard gate.
declarative_learning_event.learned_constraint: Endpoint refinements are support-only until collar realization exists.
declarative_learning_event.invalidated_generalization: Endpoint algebra alone is not a main proof advance.

demotion_trigger: Demote if the next cycle does not construct or falsify a collar object.
